description: Source code for a Kubernetes client implementation within the etcd project, providing methods for get, list, count, optimistic put, and delete operations.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A client for interacting with etcd in a Kubernetes context, wrapping the underlying clientv3.Client and providing additional methods.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Client instance from the provided configuration.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a key from etcd with specified revision.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists keys with a given prefix, supporting continuation and range.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Counts the number of keys with a given prefix.

methods.name: OptimisticPut
methods.description: Performs an optimistic concurrency control put operation.

methods.name: OptimisticDelete
methods.description: Performs an optimistic concurrency control delete operation.
